title: starter docs: the blank starter and the getting-started page tell the author to generate a second app, which a package of type app refuses (ADR-0019 D3)
body:
domain:server#7 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYm8sWjp2Pk76warN7w

Filing gate: ① misleading user-facing text with a reproduction, found by the #32212 card thread (os-dev report on #32212, out-of-scope finding class a) and confirmed by this seat on `origin/main`. ⛔ Not a claim.
Business reason: a new user who follows the starter's own instructions to add an app runs `os generate app`, which fails with exit 1 because the starter already ships its one app. Their first extension step fails.
Reader: triage first touch. The texts live in `packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/**` and `content/docs/getting-started/your-first-project.mdx`.

## What happens

On a copy of `packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank`, `os g app extra --object blank_note` exits 1 with "An app package must define at most one app, but found 2 (blank_extra_app, blank_main_app) … ADR-0019 D3". The starter has shipped `src/apps/main.app.ts` since #32209, and #32212 (PR #32291) gives `os init` the same shape.

The texts that tell the author to do it (`origin/main`, read 2026-11-10 16:40 UTC; re-check: `git grep -n "generate app\|an app of its own" origin/main -- content/docs/getting-started packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank`, control `generate view` in the same files):
- `content/docs/getting-started/your-first-project.mdx`: "a navigation entry to that app (or generate an app of its own)", followed by `npx os generate app NAME --object OBJECT`.
- `packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/README.md`: "or add an app of its own under `src/apps/`" and `objectstack generate app NAME --object OBJECT`.
- `packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/src/apps/index.ts` and `main.app.ts` comments: "`objectstack generate app NAME` writes one…".

## Expected

Each text tells the author to add a navigation entry to the starter app (a `group` entry nests them) or to replace the starter app, and none suggests a second app in the same package. Mirror the comment PR #32291 writes into `os init`'s `main.app.ts`.

Dedupe (open and closed), run 2026-11-10 16:40 UTC: `starter "at most one app" generate app` (1 hit: #32212, the card that found it).
